title: Tryout control plane configuration
description: Configuration file of the Tryout control plane. $defs/session_request is the agent API contract for POST /v1/sessions; it shares $defs/workload with the project definition.

listen.description: Address the control plane listens on, as [host]:port.

embed_frame_ancestors.description: Origins allowed to embed /embed/<project> in an iframe ('self' is always allowed).

agent_tls.description: Mutual TLS towards every agent: the control plane's client certificate and the CA that signs the agents' certificates. Paths are relative to this file's directory.

ca.description: PEM file of the CA that signs the agents' server certificates.

cert.description: PEM file of the control plane's client certificate (extended key usage clientAuth).

key.description: PEM file of the client certificate's private key.

client_ip.description: How the control plane finds a visitor's IP address, for the per-IP limits. Without trusted proxies, the address of the connection is used and forwarding headers are ignored.

trusted_proxies.description: CIDR blocks of the reverse proxies or tunnels in front of the control plane (10.0.0.0/8, fd00::/8, 192.0.2.1). Only they may report the client's address.

header.description: Header in which a trusted proxy puts the client's address (CF-Connecting-IP, X-Real-IP...). Defaults to X-Forwarded-For, read from the right.

limits.description: Per-IP limits (IPv6: per /64), across all projects. 0 disables a limit.

live_tickets_per_ip.description: Tickets an IP may hold at once: waiting, starting or active.

new_tickets_per_ip.description: Tickets an IP may create within a sliding window, released ones included.

streams_per_ip.description: Event streams an IP may keep open at once, on each control plane instance.

projects.description: Projects by name; the name is the one used in /embed/<project>.

origin.description: A scheme and host, with an optional port and an optional leading wildcard label: https://example.org, https://*.example.org, http://localhost:3000.

agent_url.description: URL of the agent's private API, over mutual TLS: https://host[:port], without a path. The agent's certificate must name the host, unless server_name is set.

server_name.description: DNS name expected in the agent's certificate, when it differs from the host of agent_url (a tunnel, a local port forward). Also sent as SNI.

public_url.description: URL template loaded by the browser; {session} is replaced by the session id.

probe_url.description: URL template reachable from the control plane, to check that a session answers. Defaults to public_url.

max_sessions.description: Cap on concurrent sessions on the node, all projects combined.
Concurrent sessions for this project. Later visitors wait in the queue.

workload.description: What runs in a session container. Shared by the configuration and the agent API.

image.description: Docker image, preferably pinned by digest.

runtime.description: Container runtime (runsc, runc...). Defaults to the node's runtime. Outside the dev profile, the agent accepts only runsc unless ALLOW_RUNC=true.

strip_prefix.description: Strip /s/<id> before forwarding, for an application that cannot serve under a base path.

limits.description: Resource limits; defaults depend on the kind.

env.description: Project environment variables. Variables set by the agent are reserved.

reserved_env.description: Variables set by the agent, which a project cannot override. Must match the agent's locked environment.
